_doc: TEMPLATE. The real manual_corrections.json is not distributed because its
'from' and 'to' fields contain participant-generated thought phrases.
Purpose: the merge between the in-scanner trial file and the pre-scan
ratings is strict (exact match on normalized phrases). Where the two
sources disagree -- typos, a missing word, an apostrophe rendered as a
space, a more specific phrase on one side -- the strict merge fails for
that row. Each correction rewrites the in-scanner key to the pre-scan key
To regenerate: run mvpa/data_merge.ipynb with an empty corrections list.
strict_merge_prescan() prints every unmatched (subject, thought_key) pair
alongside that subject's available pre-scan keys. Add one entry per pair
until nothing is unmatched. The published analyses used 22 corrections
If you received a copy of the questionnaire data with thought phrases
replaced by opaque identifiers (thought_01 ... thought_09), no corrections
are needed: the identifiers match exactly by construction. Leave the

corrections.from: <phrase as it appears in the in-scanner file>
corrections.to: <phrase as it appears in the pre-scan file>
